So I'd like to go around the room — please walk me through what each of you has found so we can assess where things stand.

Thank you all. Let me make sure I have everything straight. Maya, finance has finalized the restatement amount at $3,800,000. Daniel, securities counsel confirms the auditor's written conclusion that the revenue-recognition error requires our previously issued quarterly financial statements to be treated as no longer reliable and corrected through a restatement. Thomas, insurance counsel has confirmed that our D&O policy requires written notice to the carrier before any public release — that's a precondition we need to build into our timeline.

Under our protocol, I now have the relevant findings from legal, finance, and insurance counsel. I'm prepared to finalize the disclosure decision and filing classification. Given that the auditor has concluded the previously issued quarterly financial statements are no longer reliable and must be corrected through a restatement, the appropriate filing is a Form 10-Q/A — an amended quarterly report — to restate the prior-period financial statements. The restatement amount is $3,800,000. The audit committee meets tomorrow, so they will be notified before we file. And we will ensure written notice to the D&O carrier is delivered before any public release goes out.

Before I formalize this, does anyone have any additional findings or concerns I should be aware of?
